note: 'Fret not' wisdom: fret-not/envy-not, trust+do-good, delight, commit-way, be-still+wait, refrain-anger, meek, generous, lending, turn-from-evil, utter-wisdom, law-in-heart, wait+keep-way, mark-blameless, refuge

277585.gloss: fret not, be not envious of evildoers

dims.v: fret not, be not envious of evildoers
the self is told not to fret over evildoers or be envious of wrongdoers - refusing the corrosive envy of the wicked's prosperity

v1: 'FRET not yourself because of evildoers; be not ENVIOUS of wrongdoers' - the operation is the disciplining of a specific inner unrest: the interior refuses to burn with envy at the wicked's success.

277739.gloss: trust in the LORD and do good

dims.v: trust in the LORD and do good
the self is told to trust in the LORD and do good, dwelling in the land and befriending faithfulness - reliance joined to action
v3: 'TRUST in the LORD, and do GOOD; dwell in the land and befriend FAITHFULNESS' - the operation pairs an inner reliance with an outward doing; trust is not passive but works.
the self is told to delight in the LORD, who will give the desires of the heart - joy in God that reshapes desire
v4: 'DELIGHT yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the DESIRES of your HEART' - the operation is the cultivation of joy in God; the interior that delights in him finds its wants aligned and met.

277828.gloss: commit your way to the LORD

dims.v: commit your way to the LORD
the self is told to commit its way to the LORD and trust him to act - handing over the whole course of life
v5: 'COMMIT your way to the LORD; TRUST in him, and he will act' - the operation is the rolling of one's road onto God; the interior lets go of managing outcomes and trusts him to work.
the self is told to be still before the LORD and wait patiently, not fretting over the one who prospers - quiet, patient stillness
v7: 'Be STILL before the LORD and WAIT patiently for him; fret not yourself over the one who prospers' - the operation is an inner quiet; the interior stops agitating and holds still before God.
the self is told to refrain from anger and forsake wrath, for fretting tends only to evil - the deliberate release of anger
v8: 'REFRAIN from ANGER, and forsake WRATH! Fret not yourself; it tends only to evil' - the operation is the letting-go of anger; the interior is warned that nursed wrath breeds only harm.

277600.gloss: the meek delight in abundant peace

dims.v: the meek delight in abundant peace
the meek shall inherit the land and delight themselves in abundant peace - lowliness rewarded with peace-filled joy
v11: 'the MEEK shall inherit the land and DELIGHT themselves in abundant PEACE' - the operation is the interior contentment of the lowly; meekness ends not in loss but in a peace it delights in.

277679.gloss: the righteous is generous and gives

dims.v: the righteous is generous and gives
the wicked borrows and does not repay, but the righteous is generous and gives - open-handedness as a mark of the righteous interior
v21: 'the RIGHTEOUS is GENEROUS and gives' - the operation is open-handed giving; the righteous interior is marked by a freedom to give that the grasping wicked lacks.
he is ever lending generously, and his children become a blessing - habitual, ongoing generosity

v26: 'He is ever LENDING GENEROUSLY, and his children become a blessing' - distinct from v21's giving: this is the sustained habit, a generosity that runs through the whole life and blesses the next generation.

277716.gloss: turn from evil and do good

dims.v: turn from evil and do good
the self is told to turn away from evil and do good, so as to dwell forever - the twofold moral turn
v27: 'Turn away from EVIL and do GOOD, so shall you dwell forever' - the operation is the double movement of the will: away from evil, toward good; the interior reorients its whole direction.
the mouth of the righteous utters wisdom and his tongue speaks justice - an interior so shaped that wise, just speech flows out
v30: 'The mouth of the RIGHTEOUS utters WISDOM, and his tongue speaks JUSTICE' - the operation is speech welling from a wise interior; what the righteous heart holds, the mouth pours out as wisdom.

277754.gloss: the law in his heart, steps not slipping

dims.v: the law in his heart, steps not slipping
the law of his God is in his heart, so his steps do not slip - internalised law producing a steady walk
v31: 'The LAW of his God is in his HEART; his steps do not SLIP' - the operation is the law made inward; because it lives in the heart, the interior's walk stays sure-footed.

277773.gloss: wait for the LORD and keep his way

dims.v: wait for the LORD and keep his way
the self is told to wait for the LORD and keep his way, and he will exalt it to inherit the land - patient waiting joined to obedient keeping
v34: 'WAIT for the LORD and KEEP his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land' - distinct from v7's stillness: this waiting is active, coupled with keeping God's way while it waits.

277795.gloss: mark the blameless - the man of peace has a future

dims.v: mark the blameless - the man of peace has a future
the self bids one mark the blameless and behold the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace - a discernment that reads the end of the righteous

v37: 'MARK the BLAMELESS and behold the UPRIGHT, for there is a FUTURE for the man of peace' - the operation is a trained perception: the interior learns to look past present appearances to the righteous man's lasting end.
the LORD helps and delivers the righteous from the wicked because they take refuge in him - refuge as the ground of rescue

v40: 'The LORD helps them and delivers them... and saves them, because they TAKE REFUGE in him' - the operation closes the psalm on refuge: the whole deliverance of the righteous rests on their sheltering in God.
v4: 'he will give you the DESIRES of your heart' - the fulfilment delighting in God brings.
v11: 'the meek shall INHERIT the land' - the possession that grounds the meek's peace-filled delight.
v17: 'the LORD UPHOLDS the righteous' - the sustaining that rewards waiting and keeping his way.
